t: Lumira: Convert negative scans to color images in the browser
Convert negative scans to full-color images directly in the browser, removing the orange mask and adjusting contrast and color and exporting the result.
Convert negative scans to full-color images

Convert negative scans to full-color images right in the browser: upload a scan, remove the orange mask for each color channel, adjust exposure and contrast and color balance, then export the result. Your images aren't uploaded to any server, no software installation is needed, and it works on modest computers and smartphones. This free tool processes a single image or a whole roll quickly, preserving the original film grain and with no cloud processing. Start by dragging and dropping a file, then move the sliders until you get a natural result, and you can reset at any time. You can also export the result as PNG or JPEG to save or print it.
Upload an image to get started.
Is my image uploaded to a server?
No. Processing happens in your browser on your device, and images aren't sent to any server.
The tool supports JPEG and PNG and WebP images that your browser can open.
Yes. You can export the resulting image as PNG or JPEG with one click.
Does it work on an old computer?
Yes. Processing happens locally, and preview resolution is lowered automatically to keep things running smoothly.
